# Role Onboarding Checklist

**Project:** [Project Name]  
**Role:** [Role Title]  
**Team Member:** [Name]  
**Start Date:** [Date]  
**Onboarding Coordinator:** [Name / Email]

---

## Onboarding Overview

This checklist ensures a smooth onboarding experience for new team members joining a project role. Complete each section in order, checking off items as you go. Estimated time to complete: **[1-2 weeks]**.

---

## Week 1: Access and Setup

### Administrative Setup
- [ ] Employee/contractor paperwork completed
- [ ] Assigned desk/workspace (if applicable)
- [ ] Email account created and configured
- [ ] Calendar access granted
- [ ] Added to relevant distribution lists and Slack/Teams channels

### System Access
- [ ] VPN access configured (if applicable)
- [ ] GitHub organization membership granted
- [ ] Repository access provisioned (read/write as appropriate)
- [ ] Project management tool access (Jira, Azure DevOps, GitHub Projects, etc.)
- [ ] CI/CD pipeline access (if applicable)
- [ ] Code quality/security scanning tools access
- [ ] Shared drive or document repository access
- [ ] Communication tools (Slack, Teams, Zoom, etc.)
- [ ] [Add other systems specific to the project]

### Development Environment Setup (for technical roles)
- [ ] Dev environment setup guide reviewed
- [ ] Local development environment configured
- [ ] Build tools and dependencies installed
- [ ] Able to successfully build the project locally
- [ ] Able to run tests locally
- [ ] IDE/editor configured with recommended plugins and settings
- [ ] [Add project-specific setup steps]

---

## Week 1-2: Knowledge Transfer

### Documentation Review
- [ ] Read [Project README](../README.md)
- [ ] Read [OctoAcme Project Management Overview](../octoacme-project-management-overview.md)
- [ ] Review [OctoAcme Roles and Personas](../octoacme-roles-and-personas.md) — especially your role
- [ ] Review [RACI Matrix](../octoacme-role-raci.md) for your responsibilities
- [ ] Read [Project Initiation](../octoacme-project-initiation.md) document
- [ ] Read [Project Planning](../octoacme-project-planning.md) document
- [ ] Review [Execution and Tracking](../octoacme-execution-and-tracking.md) practices
- [ ] Understand [Release and Deployment](../octoacme-release-and-deployment.md) processes
- [ ] Review [Risks and Communication](../octoacme-risks-and-communication.md) guidelines
- [ ] Read relevant role-specific documentation and templates
- [ ] Review current project charter or one-pager
- [ ] Review active sprint/iteration plan and backlog
- [ ] [Add other project-specific documentation]

### Technical Knowledge (for technical roles)
- [ ] Architecture overview session completed
- [ ] Codebase walkthrough completed
- [ ] Key design decisions and ADRs reviewed
- [ ] Understand testing strategy and coverage goals
- [ ] Understand deployment and release process
- [ ] Reviewed recent PRs to understand code review standards
- [ ] Security and compliance requirements reviewed
- [ ] [Add project-specific technical deep dives]

---

## Week 2: Meetings and Introductions

### Team Introductions
- [ ] Met with direct manager/lead
- [ ] Introduced to immediate team members
- [ ] Met with Product Owner or Product Manager
- [ ] Met with Project Manager
- [ ] Introduced to key stakeholders relevant to the role
- [ ] Met with any team members you'll collaborate with closely
- [ ] [Add other key introductions]

### Meeting Attendance
- [ ] Added to all recurring team meetings (standups, planning, retros, etc.)
- [ ] Attended first daily standup
- [ ] Attended first sprint/iteration planning (if applicable)
- [ ] Attended sprint review/demo (if applicable)
- [ ] Attended first 1:1 with manager
- [ ] Reviewed meeting norms and participation expectations
- [ ] [Add other recurring meetings specific to the role]

### Shadowing and Learning
- [ ] Shadow a code review (for technical roles)
- [ ] Shadow a customer/stakeholder meeting (if applicable)
- [ ] Shadow a release/deployment (if applicable)
- [ ] Pair programming or pairing session with a team member
- [ ] [Add role-specific shadowing opportunities]

---

## Week 2-3: First Contributions

### Initial Tasks
- [ ] First small task/story assigned
- [ ] Understand acceptance criteria for assigned work
- [ ] Know where to ask questions (Slack channel, team member, etc.)
- [ ] Submitted first pull request or deliverable (if applicable)
- [ ] Participated in code review or document review
- [ ] Provided feedback or asked questions in a team meeting
- [ ] [Add other initial contribution milestones]

### Feedback and Check-ins
- [ ] 1-week check-in with manager completed
- [ ] Feedback provided on onboarding experience
- [ ] Questions or blockers addressed
- [ ] 2-week check-in with manager completed
- [ ] Comfort level with role responsibilities assessed

---

## Ongoing: Continuous Learning

- [ ] Bookmark key documentation and resources
- [ ] Join relevant community channels or forums
- [ ] Identify learning opportunities (courses, certifications, conferences)
- [ ] Schedule regular 1:1s with manager
- [ ] Set 30-60-90 day goals with manager
- [ ] Identify a mentor or buddy on the team (if applicable)

**Instructions for Use:**
1. Copy this checklist at the start of onboarding
2. Customize it with project-specific items, links, and contacts
3. Review progress weekly with the onboarding coordinator
4. Adjust timelines based on role complexity and team member experience
5. Collect feedback to improve the onboarding process for future team members
